column1: # GIMPhoto's Photoshop keymap: Photoshop's default shortcuts (CC 2019 and
# later, Windows/Linux keys; Ctrl = <Primary>) on the GIMP actions that do
# the same job. tools/make_keymap.py turns it into defaults/shortcutsrc.
# action <TAB> shortcuts (GTK syntax, comma-separated) <TAB> Photoshop command
# The action keeps its GIMP default shortcuts too, unless a line here takes
# them for something else (e.g. Ctrl+D: Image > Duplicate in GIMP, Deselect
# in Photoshop). Lines marked "GIMPhoto:" are not Photoshop's: they give a
# shortcut back to a GIMP command whose own one Photoshop takes. Actions
# named gimphoto-* are GIMPhoto's own plug-ins (plugins/).
